caption: 💌 SAVE this recipe for your next cozy bake day. And tag me if your little one steals one before it cools down 😅 Witch Fingers ! but make them real food 👻 No sugar, no butter, no junk. Just spooky cookies made with dates, olive oil, and spelt flour ...soft, crumbly, and toddler-approved. 🍪 👌  Perfect for toddlers, snack boxes, or spooky movie nights. 🎃 How to make them: – ¼ cup date puree – 1 tbsp peanut butter – 2 tbsp olive oil – 2 tbsp milk – ½ tsp baking powder – ½ tsp cinnamon – ½ tsp vanilla – ½ cup spelt flour – 2 tbsp corn starch Mix wet → add dry → shape into fingers → press with almond flakes → bake 12 min at 180°C. #spookytreats #toddlersnacks #healthyhalloween #calmparenting #nosugaradded
